change: Play page: added playback speed (S for 0.5x/0.75x/1x) and a loop-the-current-line practice tool (L), plus an end-of-song results card (R) with per-member accuracy bars, a new-best badge, and shareable Wordle-style result text
Sidebar search is now fuzzy across accents and spelling (press / to jump into it, arrows + Enter to pick a song), alongside filter chips for Unplayed, In progress, Mastered, and ★ Favorites
Added song favorites, Random / Random unplayed buttons, a Continue strip for picking up where you left off, and progress dots next to each song in the sidebar
Stats page: added 36 achievements across quiz, mastery, groups, streaks, and Bubudle, plus a play streak tracker and a 26-week activity heatmap
Bubudle: added a stats modal showing win %, current/max streak, a guess distribution histogram, and a countdown to the next daily
Whoranghae is now installable as a PWA: add it to your home screen for an app-like icon, offline access to pages you've visited, and faster loads from cached audio and covers
Stats page redesign — Total Mastery dials, plus a profile Export/Import JSON to move your progress between devices
Phone view tightened — sidebar nav, player bar, and slot picker now lay out cleanly at narrow widths instead of overlapping each other
Faster page loads — songs are fetched on demand instead of all upfront, the menu manifest is slimmer, and hashed assets cache aggressively across visits
Added BTS — 107-song catalog spanning the studio albums, mini-albums, OSTs, and singles
Sidebar now groups each artist's discography by album type (Studio, Mini, Single, Compilation, Digital) so the menu doesn't sprawl
Added Stray Kids — 112 songs across studio releases, mini-albums, repackaged editions, compilations, and digital singles
Added TWICE — 150-song catalog with the new album-type grouping baked in
Added a Hints button — turn it on to show a Singers: N badge under each slot for the songs you can't crack
Bubudle: added a Daily mode (one shared clip per day across all players) and a cross-group All scope
Added a FULL COMBO banner that flashes when you finish a song at 100%
Whoranghae is now packaged as an Android app — same site, no browser frame
On mobile, the sidebar now layers above the player bar so the menu stops getting pinned underneath when you open it mid-song
Added a small Ko-fi tip jar (bottom-left popover, dismissible) — totally optional, but if this game has been worth your time, tips are very welcome >.<
Added the Japanese SEVENTEEN catalog — 5 JP releases — alongside a native-lyrics toggle that flips between 한 and JP
Added SEVENTEEN as the founding K-pop group — 113 songs across the catalog, with member colors, group art, and per-album sidebar grouping
Whoranghae launched. A brand-new K-pop mode of the site, branded and deployed separately from the anime side, built on the same engine that powers BubuDesuWho
